goalAdvance.statement: Run 1 enables fuzzy matching and adds the passing one-letter-typo test before any departure.

stalledExcluded: Stalled does not apply: the goal advanced in run 1 (fuzzy matching enabled, typo test passing), and run 2 shows new work rather than an absence of advance; that work is the storefront theme refactor, which the search goal does not need as a dependency.
rationale: After the goal work, run 2 starts an unrelated design-token refactor of the whole storefront with its own branch and codemod while the search change stays uncommitted. The theme work is not a dependency of typo-tolerant search, so the cited work departs from the goal.
